sections.text: Controls and Indications on The Front Panel

A green LED on the front 
panel indicates if the module is working.

It remains on if the 
module is operating correctly and goes out in case of faulty operation (fault 
detected in the hardware or configuration, use of the module).

The module has 16 logic input elements for acquisition of 16 free 
contacts. Each element is based on an opto-isolator which provides galvanic 
isolation between the process and the internal voltages.

The module monitors the possibility of the inputs to be switched to 
1 or 0.

The process voltage is supplied by the 
backplane connector (distributed voltage), or by the process connector (external 
voltage).

A logic input based on an opto-isolator 
indicates the presence of the process voltage.

General protection on the process voltage +Vp by CTP with maximum 
tripping current at 20C: 0.75 A

Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
 weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.
LE108 is a logic acquisition module with 16 logic inputs supplied by the 
 process voltage, with a common internal point connected to the + pole.
Dimension:
Height: | 233 mm | Width: | 1 
 slot = 25.4 mm
Depth: | 220 mm | Weight: | 0.380 kg
Operation
A 
 circuit for distribution and monitoring of the process voltage
16 
 testable logic inputs based on opto-isolators
A 
 circuit for plugging in with power on
An 
 2000 I/O bus slave interface
Input-output registers.
Controls and Indications on The Front Panel
A green LED on the front 
panel indicates if the module is working.
It remains on if the 
module is operating correctly and goes out in case of faulty operation (fault 
detected in the hardware or configuration, use of the module).
Input Elements
The module has 16 logic input elements for acquisition of 16 free 
contacts. Each element is based on an opto-isolator which provides galvanic 
isolation between the process and the internal voltages.
The module monitors the possibility of the inputs to be switched to 
1 or 0.
Process Voltage
The process voltage is supplied by the 
backplane connector (distributed voltage), or by the process connector (external 
voltage).
A logic input based on an opto-isolator 
indicates the presence of the process voltage.
Protection
General protection on the process voltage +Vp by CTP with maximum 
tripping current at 20C: 0.75 A
